aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, including a subset of 116 lethal prostate cancer cases; the abstract does not provide further clinical criteria for either endpoint.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: In a prospective case-control study of 156 pairs of advanced prostate cancer cases and controls, we directly measured prediagnostic circulating 25(OH)D and VDBP and calculated bioavailable 25(OH)D using a validated formula.
study_design: Prospective matched case-control study using prediagnostic circulating biomarkers
cohort_total_n_excerpt: In a prospective case-control study of 156 pairs of advanced prostate cancer cases and controls, we directly measured prediagnostic circulating 25(OH)D and VDBP and calculated bioavailable 25(OH)D using a validated formula.
reason: The study evaluates prediagnostic biomarkers in 156 advanced prostate cancer case-control pairs and separately reports analyses restricted to 116 lethal cases. These are aggressive incident endpoints; no overall prostate cancer endpoint is analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared to those with total 25(OH)D levels below the median and VDBP levels above the median (at highest risk), men with both levels above the median had a multivariable-adjusted OR of 0.31 (95% CI, 0.15-0.65) for advanced prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns advanced prostate cancer and matches the reported joint total 25(OH)D/VDBP comparison.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared to total 25(OH)D (p<sub>trend</sub> = 0.02), bioavailable 25(OH)D levels were not more strongly associated with risk of advanced prostate cancer (p<sub>trend</sub> = 0.14).
estimate_classifications.reason: The abstract establishes that total 25(OH)D was analyzed in relation to advanced prostate cancer, although the row's quartile-specific OR and confidence interval come from the supplied full-text evidence.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
